title: List of districts of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Indian Union territory of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands consists of three districts.

rows: Nicobar – 1,841 km2 (711 sq mi) (smallest); North and Middle Andaman –3,227 km2 (1,246 sq mi) (largest)
Sub Divisions of Andaman and Nicobar Islands

sections.heading: Districts
sections.text: Currently, the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands comprises 3 districts:

sections.heading: History
sections.text: On 1 August 1974 Nicobar district was separated from Andaman district. On 18 August 2006, Andaman district was bifurcated into two districts: North and Middle Andaman district and South Andaman district.
